name: locker-agentic
description: The agent trades. It holds nothing. Locker Protocol Agentic skills and session-start readiness for the lpa command: Hyperliquid perps, paper trading on the real order book, market regime, and keys that stay offline in Locker Vault.

interface.shortDescription: lpa skills for Hyperliquid perps, with the keys offline in Locker Vault
interface.longDescription: The agent trades. It holds nothing. Skills for the lpa command of Locker Protocol Agentic: quote, open, modify and close Hyperliquid perps positions, trade on paper on the real order book, read a market's regime, check the local policy and the journal. The account's private key stays in Locker Vault, an offline app on a phone; this computer holds only an agent key that Hyperliquid refuses every withdrawal and every send (a deposit into a Hyperliquid vault is the one movement it accepts, and lpa never signs it), and every movement of funds is signed on the phone.
defaultPrompt: Open a paper account with lpa and quote a long on BTC.
What is the regime of ETH on Hyperliquid right now?
Check my Locker Protocol Agentic setup with lpa doctor.
